properties.name: jwt.secret
properties.description: HMAC signing key used to validate incoming JWTs. Must be the IDENTICAL value configured in garbigo-auth-service, or every signature check on an incoming token fails.

properties.name: internal.api-key
properties.description: Shared secret sent on the X-Internal-Api-Key header of outgoing Feign calls. Must be the IDENTICAL value configured in garbigo-auth-service's InternalApiKeyFilter.

properties.name: rabbitmq.queue.user-created
properties.description: Name of auth-service's existing RabbitMQ queue this service consumes user-created events from. Same property path and env var name (RABBITMQ_QUEUE_USER_CREATED) as auth-service uses on the publishing side.

properties.name: rabbitmq.purge-queues-on-startup
properties.description: Opt-in, code-only alternative to purging queues from the RabbitMQ management UI. Off by default - see QueuePurgeRunner.

properties.name: services.auth.base-url
properties.description: Base URL AuthServiceClient uses to call garbigo-auth-service over Feign.

properties.name: services.wallet.base-url
properties.description: Base URL WalletServiceClient will use to call garbigo-wallet-service over Feign, once that service exists. Not called anywhere yet.

properties.name: app.name
properties.description: Display name shown in the header of outgoing HTML emails.

properties.name: app.url
properties.description: Front-end app URL linked from outgoing HTML emails (e.g. the "View in Garbigo" button).

properties.name: app.support-email
properties.description: Support contact address shown in the footer of outgoing HTML emails.

properties.name: app.company.name
properties.description: Company name shown in the footer and copyright line of outgoing HTML emails.

properties.name: app.company.address
properties.description: Company address shown in the footer of outgoing HTML emails.

properties.name: collections.cancellation-cutoff-hours
properties.description: How close to scheduledAt a client can still cancel a collection or sewage request without it being blocked.

properties.name: rate-limit.requests-per-minute
properties.description: Requests per client IP per minute before RateLimitFilter returns 429. Same property name/style as auth-service's own rate-limit.requests-per-minute.

properties.name: scheduling.recurring-requests.cron
properties.description: Spring cron (evaluated in UTC) for the job that generates requests from recurring schedules and sends day-before reminders. Set to "-" to disable.

properties.name: scheduling.user-directory-sync.cron
properties.description: Spring cron (evaluated in UTC) for the job that refreshes the local user cache from auth-service. Set to "-" to disable.
